edge.title: Circuit-Muon: per-head coupling of attention V/O Muon updates
edge.summary: Adds Circuit-Muon to #40's stack: each block's attn.v/attn.proj pair is updated in a separate coupled pass (computed redundantly on every rank) instead of the sharded round-robin. After each leg's unchanged direction pipeline (momentum → SOAP for V → Contra/NS), V's update is scaled per head by its partner's inverse scalar Gram root s_O,h = (‖W_O,h‖²/128 + 1e-3)^−½ (and O's by s_V,h), each leg is renormalized to its pre-scaling Frobenius norm so only the cross-head anisotropy survives, and the per-head component along the scaling-gauge direction (W_V,h, −W_O,h) is projected out. Intent (README): keep the per-head change of the composed OV map W_O,h·W_V,h balanced as factor norms evolve and stop first-order drift of ‖W_V,h‖² − ‖W_O,h‖²; the radial brake, u/w floor and radius rescale then act per matrix as before.

changes.label: Circuit-Muon OV coupling
changes.detail: circuit_muon() multiplies V/O update heads by the partner's 1/sqrt(‖W_h‖²/hd + λ), restores each leg's total Frobenius norm, then subtracts x_h·(W_V,h, −W_O,h) with x_h = (⟨W_V,h,dV_h⟩ − ⟨W_O,h,dO_h⟩)/(‖W_V,h‖² + ‖W_O,h‖² + 2·hd·λ).

changes.label: V/O moved to a coupled pass
changes.detail: Muon.step first runs _circuit_muon_step over the 12 (attn.v, attn.proj) pairs on every rank (_direction → circuit_muon → _finish), then round-robins the other 48 matrices; each leg's SOAP/Contra/NS pipeline and radial/floor/radius post-processing are unchanged.

changes.label: Docstring, logging, helper methods
changes.detail: New docstring and EXPERIMENT_NAME/INTUITION, two extra log lines; _ensure_state/_direction/_finish restate the existing inline per-param body for use by the coupled pass.

edge.parent_check: consistent: c41_p40 only adds the Circuit-Muon function, the coupled V/O pass and logging; every #40 constant is unchanged.
edge.noise: Docstring/experiment-name rewrite, extra print0 lines, and helper methods (_ensure_state/_direction/_finish) that duplicate the inline per-param body.

techniques.note: 12 NS iters (a,b,c = 2,−1.5,0.5) on Schatten-4-normalized input; Nesterov-EMA μ; √max(1,m/n)
mlp.fc & mlp.proj: eigenbasis-Adam on momentum, basis refresh every 10 steps, β2 0.90
attn.v only (SOAP blend 0.95, denom floor 0.55); attn.proj trust-gate code dormant
−0.2 × unit-norm momentum added around the NS step, ramped linearly to 0 by step 2500
wide mlp.proj only: 3 D-rescaled NS passes (β=0.25) toward uniform per-hidden-unit leverage
12 attn.v↔attn.proj pairs, 6×128 heads: partner post-whiten + gauge projection, λ=1e-3
outward radial part of the update ×0.5; post-step rescale to first-order target radius
update scaled up so ‖U‖F/‖W‖F ≥ 0.3825 on every Muon matrix; no weight decay
lookahead 0.3·lr/lr0 along EMA(0.99) of per-step displacement, steps 300–1950
min(lr0, c·(2980−t)^1.2) per group: Muon decays from ~594, Adam groups from ~1567
μ 0.85→0.95 over first 300 steps; 0.95→0.85 over steps 2800–2900
every param named *proj* zeroed: attn.proj, mlp.proj, lm head (weights and biases)
norm1/norm2 gains = 1 ∓ 0.14·s, s Rademacher per channel, all 12 blocks
fused AdamW (bias-corrected): embed 0.3, head 1/320, 1-D 0.01; β(0.8,0.99), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon (SOAP on mlp.fc/mlp.proj/attn.v) + Contra + Aurora + Circuit-Muon

mechanisms.name: Circuit-Muon (attention OV coupling)
mechanisms.explain: For each block the V update (heads on rows) and O update (heads on columns) from the normal pipeline are split into 6 heads of 128; with s_V,h = (‖W_V,h‖²/128 + λ)^−½ and s_O,h likewise, dV_h is multiplied by s_O,h and dO_h by s_V,h, then each leg is rescaled back to its original total Frobenius norm. Next x_h = (⟨W_V,h,dV_h⟩ − ⟨W_O,h,dO_h⟩)/(‖W_V,h‖² + ‖W_O,h‖² + 2·128·λ), and dV_h −= x_h·W_V,h, dO_h += x_h·W_O,h removes the component along the rescaling gauge (W_V,h, −W_O,h) that leaves W_O,h·W_V,h unchanged. λ = 1e-3 bounds the scalars at init (zero-init W_O gives s_O ≈ 31.6).

caveats: README reports n=20 seeds but the results folder holds a single log. The trace-gap conservation is first-order and holds only before post-processing: the radial brake, u/w floor and radius rescale that follow act on whole matrices. Soft-Muon (SOFT_MUON_CEIL=0) and NorMuon-lite (NOR_BETA2=1.0 ⇒ second moment stays zero, uniform rescale undone) remain in the code but are inactive, so they are not listed.
